what_changed: Replaced the full response scratch path with a fused direct energy kernel for short epochs and null handles.
Added per-call Gram preparation and direct quadratic energy evaluation when the shape-based arithmetic model favors reuse.
Preserved the candidate_api.h ABI and support for a null cuBLAS handle.
limitations: GPU execution was unavailable in this namespace; numerical acceptance and runtime behavior are unverified.
No latency or device-memory measurement was made, so no speedup is claimed.
The arithmetic dispatch threshold is a hypothesis and needs full-epoch evaluator measurements.
